langbot.title: Message channels
langbot.subtitle: Hand IM chats to platform Agents through LangBot. This page manages the platform-side mapping; Bot pipelines stay in the LangBot WebUI.
langbot.identityNotice: The execution identity is always the channel owner: group members and direct-message users never run Agents as themselves, but with the owner's workspace and quota.

common.unauthorizedDescription: Your account cannot view this organization's message channels. Contact an organization administrator.

bots.emptyDescription: Create a LangBot Bot and its IM chats can be handled by platform Agents.
bots.missingInLangbot: This Bot no longer exists in LangBot
bots.noBotUuid: The platform record has no Bot UUID, so this action is unavailable
bots.deleteDescription: This deletes the Bot in LangBot and cascades to platform routes and conversation mappings. It cannot be undone.

form.name: Name
form.configHint: The configuration is passed through to LangBot only. The platform never stores or echoes it; inspect it in the LangBot WebUI after creation.
form.configEditHint: Configuration is replaced as a whole when editing: leave it empty to keep the existing LangBot configuration, or provide the complete JSON.
form.configNotObject: Configuration must be a JSON object
form.secretHint: Entered as passwords and merged into the configuration. Values are never echoed after submission.
form.secretIncomplete: Secret fields need both a name and a value
form.noChanges: There are no changes to save
form.customHint: Plugin adapters are provided by LangBot plugins; enter their configuration as JSON.

test.title: Test send
test.targetIdPlaceholder: IM user ID or group ID
test.required: Enter a target ID and text

routes.disableDescription: Once disabled, inbound messages from this chat are no longer routed to this Agent until you enable it again.
routes.deleteDescription: After deletion, the chat's next inbound message will match routes again.

form.chatIdHint: Leave empty for a wildcard route of this chat type; exact routes take precedence.
form.agentHint: Only Agent configurations visible to your account are listed; at runtime they must also be visible to the channel owner.
form.agentListFailed: Agent configurations could not be loaded, so routes cannot be saved

diagnostics.conversationsEmptyDescription: Once a channel receives and delivers its first message, the chat's conversation mapping appears here.
diagnostics.eventsUnavailableDescription: The control plane currently exposes conversation mappings only and has no event query endpoint, so event status, delivery method and ACK cannot be shown here.
